issues.desc: The simple senior-bundle completion signal is still implicit. The checklist should make the user-observable finish line explicit: a developer can reuse the same server-generated senior bundle across codex-cli, claude-code, Antigravity, or a future host by changing only the host declaration such as LATTICE_AUTHORITY_RUNNER_PROVIDER, including register/heartbeat/SSE/claim/takeover paths, without a new server-side per-host manual setup step beyond normal server policy authorization.

A related required doc still says LATTICE_AUTHORITY_RUNNER_PROVIDER is limited to codex, claude-code, and gemini and that invalid provider values fail closed. Because this story exists to replace local closed-enum rejection with host-neutral declaration propagation, the INIT scope should require aligning that doc/diagnostic contract so onboarding users are not told the opposite of the intended product behavior.
